speaker: narrator
text: Part seven. Milo's safe. Bit's dock is *plugged in*.

speaker: hero
text: The dock is plugged *into the wall*.

speaker: narrator
text: If power comes back, the surge hits *Bit*.

speaker: narrator
text: Down the hill, the town lights *blink*.

speaker: friend
text: They're turning the power *back on*!

speaker: narrator
text: Jay runs. Two miles. *Downhill*.

speaker: narrator
text: His legs burn. His lungs burn. He *keeps going*.

speaker: narrator
text: Mayor Doyle is at the town *switch*.

speaker: boss
text: Storm's over! Lights in three, two...

speaker: narrator
text: The sky flares red *again*.

speaker: narrator
text: A second wave. Storms like this come in *pieces*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay bursts through his door. The dock is *humming*.

speaker: narrator
text: He grabs the cable. *Pulls*.

speaker: narrator
text: A spark. A bang. Then the street goes *dark*.

speaker: narrator
text: The town transformer is *fried*.

speaker: narrator
text: No power for *three days*. That's the cost.

speaker: narrator
text: But the cable is in Jay's *hand*.

speaker: narrator
text: Morning. The sky is *blue* again.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay presses Bit's power button. *Nothing*.

speaker: narrator
text: Part eight drops in two days. The final part.
